description: A cheaper, roomier variant of the Hut. Villagers rest and reproduce here, one hut houses four tribesmen.
name: Large Hut

source.notes: Base values are the decoded Hut (type 2) from PD0-ANALYSIS.md section 3: size 2x2, HP 25/40/90, build cost rows 13-15 = 5/10/0, upgrade cost rows 10-12 = 15/5/0, mood rows 21-23 = 0/2/0, worker capacity record 80 = 3, living space +4. This variant is cheaper to build (3/6/0 instead of 5/10/0) and cheaper to upgrade (12/4/0 instead of 15/5/0), but has about 20 percent less HP at every level (20/32/72 instead of 25/40/90). Resource order wood/stone/bones = stock [2]/[3]/[4] is inferred, not proven; see MOD-FORMAT.md section 6.
